content: A minimalist studio photograph of a round analog wall clock mounted on a smooth light gray wall, centered in frame and viewed straight on. The clock has a matte black circular frame, a clean white face, black Arabic numerals 1 through 12, and thin black minute tick marks around the entire dial with thicker hour marks at each numeral. Show exactly 12 numerals and 60 minute divisions. The time displayed is {argument name="clock time" default="05:29"}: the short hour hand is slightly past 5, the longer minute hand points to the 29-minute mark just before the 6, and a very thin black second hand is near the lower part of the dial around the 31-second position. Soft even lighting, subtle realistic shadow on the wall, high-detail product-photography realism, neutral modern interior aesthetic, no branding, no extra objects, square composition.

A dynamic anime illustration of a {argument name="character age vibe" default="teen girl"} with long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} twin tails tied with 2 oversized pink ribbon bows shaped like cat ears, vivid blue eyes, and a serious confident expression. She is posed in an exaggerated chuunibyou-style stance, one hand spread dramatically in front of the camera with strong foreshortening and all five fingers clearly visible, the other hand framing one eye, as if casting a spell or controlling a digital field. She wears a white lab coat over a dark navy school uniform with a collared shirt, vest, tie, and pleated skirt. The scene is a futuristic neon laboratory or cyber-magic room filled with glowing purple and blue light, floating holographic interface fragments, a bright horizontal audio waveform crossing the background, and a curved row of 11 translucent rectangular cards or panels floating on the left side. On the right side, a ring of 10 floating cat-face emoji icons glows in pink, purple, and blue, with different cute and mischievous expressions. Add one large glass bottle in the lower left foreground. Her long hair streams outward with motion, and purple energy ribbons swirl around her body. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, high contrast, glossy highlights, detailed fingers, intense perspective, sparkling particles, and polished high-end anime key visual rendering in a mystical cyberpunk palette of violet, indigo, and magenta.

A bright, cheerful 2D side-scrolling platform game scene in a polished cartoon style, showing a cute white blob-like mascot character standing on a grassy dirt platform in the lower left foreground. The character is tiny and round with a smooth white body, stubby feet, big glossy black eyes with white highlights, and a small smiling mouth, facing slightly right. The environment is a futuristic fantasy landscape under a vivid blue sky with large soft white clouds. Across the scene are exactly 5 floating rectangular hover platforms with rounded corners, white tops, orange undersides, and glowing cyan light panels on the front; one is low near the character, one is center-low, one is center-middle, one is upper-right-middle, and one is top-right. Above the middle of the scene is an arc of exactly 5 glowing ring collectibles, alternating orange and cyan, with small sparkles and tiny white particle dots tracing the jump path between them. The level includes exactly 3 visible grassy ground platforms made of lush green turf over brown soil with rounded cutaway edges: one at far left foreground, one at lower center-left where the character stands, and one at far right foreground. In the background, add rolling green hills, atmospheric blue mountains, and a whimsical futuristic city with smooth white towers and domed buildings accented with cyan-blue windows. Include exactly 3 floating islands with grass tops and small dome structures: one mid-left, one mid-right, and one tiny distant island near the right side. Decorate the foreground with small flowers and bushes. Use saturated colors, clean vector-like outlines, soft lighting, gentle bloom around glowing objects, and a playful mobile-game aesthetic reminiscent of a friendly sci-fi platformer splash screen. Wide cinematic composition, side view, no UI, no text.

A polished Japanese anime theatrical movie poster in vertical one-sheet format, painted with high-end cinematic detail and luminous natural lighting. The composition features exactly 6 youths arranged in a dramatic ensemble portrait against a bright blue sky with soft clouds, distant white birds, reflective water, lush green foliage in the foreground, and a partially overgrown futuristic eco-city ruin on the left background, blending nature and advanced science. At the top center, two main characters stand back-to-back as the visual anchor: on the left, a tall teenage boy with messy short white hair, pale skin, a calm serious expression, and a white lab coat over a shirt and tie, shown in side profile facing left; on the right, a tall teenage girl with black hair in a neat bun, pale skin, a composed expression, and a dark school-uniform-inspired outfit with a white collar and ribbon at the neck, shown in side profile facing right. Below them in the center foreground stands a schoolgirl with a straight black bob haircut, pale skin, and a black uniform with a large deep red bow, facing forward with a quiet, introspective presence. On the mid-left stands a dark-haired teenage boy in a dark suit and tie, shown in side profile facing left. On the mid-right stands a tousle-haired brown-haired teenage boy wearing a blue hoodie under a dark jacket, shown in side profile facing right. On the lower left stands a light-brown-haired teenage girl with long soft waves, wearing a pale pink cardigan over a light top, one hand near her chest, looking gentle and slightly anxious. Make every character anatomically consistent and clearly separated, with elegant hair rendering, refined fabric folds, and emotionally restrained expressions. Use warm rim light and soft atmospheric glow, with subtle lens bloom and painterly highlights to create a hopeful, contemplative mood. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the design: a vertical tagline on the upper left reading "その選択が、未来の景色を変える。", a vertical tagline on the upper right reading "自然と、科学と、心をつなぐ旅へ。", small text above the title reading "劇場アニメーション映画", a large glowing main title near the lower center reading "{argument name="film title" default="エコテイクノート"}", a subtitle below it reading "{argument name="subtitle text" default="― 未来への選択 ―"}", exactly 3 award laurels arranged in a row beneath the title with small Japanese festival text inside each, a row of exactly 6 character name labels near the bottom above the credits, dense small Japanese credit lines across the bottom, social and website text in very small print, and a large release date at the lower right reading "{argument name="release date" default="8.22 FRI"}" with a smaller line below reading "全国ロードショー". Keep the overall look like a premium contemporary anime key visual poster for an emotional science-and-nature coming-of-age ensemble film.

A clean corporate parody graphic on a plain light gray background, centered horizontally, styled like an official Microsoft product banner. On the left, show a layered cluster of 4 overlapping Microsoft Office-like app icons with glossy 3D depth and soft shadows: 1 large blue square tile in front with a bold white capital letter P, 1 orange rounded rectangle behind it at the upper left with a white pie-chart symbol, 1 white document sheet in the middle with a folded top-right corner, three blue horizontal text lines and a blue bar chart at the bottom, and 1 green spreadsheet tile behind on the right with a white grid pattern. On the right side, place the word Microsoft in small dark gray sans-serif type above a large product-name line that reads {argument name="headline text" default="Power harassment Ex"}. Render the large title in a Microsoft-style multicolor gradient spanning warm orange-red into purple-blue and cyan, with a crisp modern sans-serif look. Keep the composition minimal, wide, and balanced, with lots of empty space, resembling a polished tech company branding image or fake software logo announcement.

A clean minimalist tech logo composition on a light gray background, wide horizontal layout. On the left, show a stacked cluster of 4 overlapping Microsoft Office-style app icons with soft gradients, rounded corners, subtle depth, and glossy modern vector shading. The front icon is a large blue square tile with a smaller raised blue panel containing a bold white capital P. Behind and slightly above it, place an orange presentation icon with a white pie-chart symbol. Behind the blue icon to the right, place a white document page icon with a folded blue corner and 4 horizontal blue text lines. At the back on the right, place a green spreadsheet icon with a white grid. Arrange the 4 icons so they overlap tightly and read as a unified hybrid Office app mark. On the right side, place the product name in a clean sans-serif font: small black text reading Microsoft above a large multicolor wordmark reading {argument name="headline text" default="PowerWordEx"}. Color the word in segmented Microsoft-style hues: warm orange-red for Power, deep blue for Word, and teal-green for Ex. Center the whole composition vertically, keep generous whitespace, and render it as polished corporate branding mockup, crisp vector illustration, soft shadowing, no extra objects.

A single-panel Japanese comic-style illustration on a light wooden floor, drawn in a soft, detailed, slightly vintage manga-anime style with clean ink outlines and muted warm colors. In the center, a young woman kneels on the floor in a gray cockatiel kigurumi pajama suit with a white belly panel and small gray wings, while wearing an oversized yellow cockatiel hood shaped like a bird’s head with crest, round black eyes, orange cheek patches, and a beak above her forehead. She holds both sides of the hood in shock, her posture frozen and guilty, with a large rectangular censor block covering the center of her face. Across the floor in front of her is a huge mess of spilled birdseed: mixed grains, pellets, shells, and seeds scattered widely in a dense irregular pile. On the left lies 1 overturned white seed cup spilling its contents, and in the lower left corner 1 vacuum cleaner floor head points toward the mess, with part of the hose visible at the lower right edge. On the right stands 1 real cockatiel, small and curious, with a yellow face, orange cheeks, pale body, gray wings, and a raised crest, looking toward the kneeling woman; next to the bird is 1 small speech bubble containing a question mark. The background is simple indoor flooring with dramatic dark vertical stress lines filling the upper half to heighten panic. Add 4 Japanese text elements integrated like manga lettering: a huge sound effect 「ガーン」 at the upper left, 1 vertical thought bubble on the left reading 「やっちゃった…」, 1 large vertical spiky speech bubble on the upper right reading 「これ…掃除機かけるの…？無理ゲーすぎる…！」, and 1 beige caption box at the bottom right reading 「オカメ飼い、あるある。」. The mood is comedic embarrassment and domestic disaster, as if illustrating a relatable bird-owner mistake.

A gritty cyberpunk anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Miyamoto Iori"}, a {argument name="character age" default="19"}-year-old FPV drone racer, standing in three-quarter back view inside a vast ruined industrial racing arena at night. She has black hair tied in a messy high ponytail, pale skin, and wears a glossy black tactical flight suit covered in patches, straps, cables, and sponsor markings. A massive hard-shell backpack radio rig with long antennas and decals is mounted on her back, and an ID badge hangs from her waist. Her face is mostly hidden in profile and partially obscured, creating a mysterious mood. The environment is dense with steel beams, catwalks, hanging wires, broken windows, concrete pillars, wet reflective floors, and layered signage. Multiple FPV racing drones are actively flying through the arena, leaving bright curved light trails in white, cyan, and red that loop through the scene and guide the eye into depth. Include exactly 6 visible drones in the distance and midground. Add large weathered signs reading "SECTION C", "FREEDOM, SPEED, ONLY", and "LAP 07 KEEP FLYING", plus a vertical character info block in the upper left with the text "{argument name="nameplate text" default="MIYAMOTO IORI"}", "AGE: {argument name="age text" default="19"}", "FPV DRONE RACER", the Japanese quote "私は、飛ぶ者だ。" and the English line "I am the one who flies." Also include a short stat list reading "RANKING // 2", "WINS // 11", "PODIUMS // 23", and "STYLE // GHOST". On her suit and gear, show readable decals including "AXIS", "Fly Beyond", "BRX", "IORI 027", and an ID card labeled "PILOT MIYAMOTO IORI". Use a dark monochrome palette with steel gray, black, and muted brown, punctuated by neon racing trails and small white light sources. Cinematic backlighting, rain-soaked reflections, heavy texture, intricate linework, urban decay, high contrast, moody atmosphere, highly detailed anime-concept-art aesthetic, vertical poster composition.

Create a hyper-detailed cinematic parody movie poster featuring an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu as an extreme bodybuilding powerlifting hero, centered in a full frontal deep squat while holding a massively overloaded barbell across his shoulders. The dog has a realistic Shiba Inu head with a calm, confident expression, warm orange-and-cream fur, upright ears, and direct eye contact. The body is exaggeratedly muscular and humanlike, with huge deltoids, chest, arms, abs, quads, and calves, rendered with glossy dramatic highlights and dense texture in the fur and skin. He wears only tight black lifting shorts and a dark lifting belt. The squat stance is low and powerful, knees bent wide, feet planted on a wet reflective rooftop or industrial platform at night. Put a modern city skyline in the background with illuminated skyscrapers, bluish haze, smoke, and two bright stadium floodlights in the upper left and upper right creating strong rim light and a heroic sports-arena mood. The composition should be perfectly centered and symmetrical, with the barbell extending horizontally across the frame and stacked with many large black weight plates on both sides. Use a high-contrast teal, amber, black, and gold color palette with intense cinematic grading, sharp focus on the character, and atmospheric glow around the lights. Add stylized poster typography: at the very top, a gold all-caps tagline reading {argument name="top tagline" default="NO PAIN. MUCH GAIN. SUCH LEGEND."}. Add 2 blocks of small white Japanese copy, 1 on the left of the character and 1 on the right, each set in 2 lines. At the bottom, place a gigantic cracked stone-textured gold title in all caps reading {argument name="movie title" default="SQUAT HERO"}. Beneath it, add a red all-caps subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle" default="LEG DAY IS DESTINY."}. Add a small red stamp-like Japanese label near the lower right of the title. Include dense tiny mock film-poster credits in white across the lower center, a ratings box in the lower left, 3 tiny studio or audio logos in the lower right, and a centered release line near the bottom reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON TO A GYM NEAR YOU"}. Make it look like a polished blockbuster action-comedy sports film poster with absurdly epic intensity, photoreal rendering, dramatic shadows, volumetric smoke, reflective ground, and premium theatrical poster design.
